## Specification

### Component: Button

A native `<button>` for a single action, with press feedback, variants, sizes and a loading state.

#### Anatomy
- `<button class="ui-btn [ui-btn-<variant>] [ui-btn-<size>] [ui-btn-icon]">` — content: optional icon(s) + label.
- Loading adds `<span class="ui-btn-spinner" aria-hidden="true">` as the first child.
- `ButtonGroup`: `<div role="group" class="ui-btn-group">` joining adjacent buttons.

#### Props
- `variant`: `primary` (default) · `secondary` · `outline` · `ghost` · `soft` · `destructive` · `link`.
- `size`: `xs` 28px · `sm` 32px · `md` 36px (default) · `lg` 44px.
- `icon`: square icon-only button (requires `aria-label`).
- `loading`: shows the spinner, sets `aria-busy="true"` and `aria-disabled="true"`, swallows clicks, keeps focus and width (does **not** set `disabled`).
- `asChild`: render the child (e.g. a link) with the button classes.
- `type` defaults to `"button"`.

#### Visual rules
- Text 14px/500, gap 8px, padding-inline 16px, radius `--radius-md`, 1px transparent border.
- Foreground lives in `--ui-btn-fg` per variant so the loading state can hide the label with `color: transparent` while the spinner keeps the variant colour.
- Hover tints only on `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` devices.
- Outline: `--ui-border-strong` border + `--ui-shadow-xs`. Ghost/outline hover: `--ui-accent`.
- Disabled: opacity .5; disabled outline/secondary keep their shape with a muted fill.

#### Motion
- Press: `scale(.97)` with `--ui-spring-snappy` (icon buttons `.94`); none when `aria-haspopup` is set.
- Colours transition with `--ui-duration-fast` + `--ui-ease-standard`.
- Spinner: 16px ring, 2px border, right side transparent, `ui-spin .7s linear infinite`.

#### Accessibility
- Native button: Enter and Space activate it.
- Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`. Loading uses `aria-busy`; focus is never lost.
- Focus ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)` on `:focus-visible`.

#### Acceptance checks
- All variants and sizes render at the listed heights; icon buttons are square.
- Clicking a loading button does nothing; it stays focusable and keeps its width.
- Works in light and dark mode and with every `data-accent`.

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/button/button.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type HTMLAttributes, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';

export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'soft' | 'destructive' | 'link';
export type ButtonSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** Visual weight. Use one primary action per surface. Default `primary`. */
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  /** Height and padding: 28 / 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ButtonSize;
  /** Square icon-only button. Give it an `aria-label`. */
  icon?: boolean;
  /**
   * Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks while keeping focus
   * (it does not set `disabled`, so keyboard focus is not lost mid-action).
   */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Render the child element instead (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`), keeping button styles. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export function buttonClassName({
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  icon = false,
  className,
}: Pick<ButtonProps, 'variant' | 'size' | 'icon' | 'className'> = {}) {
  return cn(
    'ui-btn',
    variant !== 'primary' && `ui-btn-${variant}`,
    size !== 'md' && `ui-btn-${size}`,
    icon && 'ui-btn-icon',
    className,
  );
}

/**
 * Button — a native button with press feedback, variants, sizes and a
 * loading state. A client component (it guards clicks while loading);
 * use buttonClassName() for a zero-JS button in Server Components.
 */
export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  { variant, size, icon, loading = false, asChild = false, className, type, onClick, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const classes = buttonClassName({ variant, size, icon, className });

  if (asChild) {
    return (
      <Slot ref={ref} className={classes} aria-busy={loading || undefined} {...(props as HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)}>
        {children}
      </Slot>
    );
  }

  const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (loading) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    onClick?.(e);
  };

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type ?? 'button'}
      className={classes}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      aria-disabled={loading || undefined}
      onClick={handleClick}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading && <span className="ui-btn-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

export interface ButtonGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {}

/** Joins adjacent buttons into one control. */
export const ButtonGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ButtonGroupProps>(function ButtonGroup(
  { className, role = 'group', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} role={role} className={cn('ui-btn-group', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/button.css`

```css
/* Button ------------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-btn  + variant: -primary (default) -secondary -outline -ghost -soft
                       -destructive -link
            + size:    -xs -sm (md default) -lg   + -icon (square)
   States: :disabled, [aria-disabled], [aria-busy="true"] (spinner, width kept)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-btn {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-primary);
    --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
    color: var(--ui-btn-fg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-btn:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
  }
  .ui-btn:active:not(:disabled, [aria-disabled="true"], [aria-busy="true"]) { transform: scale(0.97); }
  /* A press on a button that anchors a popup answers with colour, not scale */
  .ui-btn[aria-haspopup]:active { transform: none; }
  .ui-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-btn:disabled,
  .ui-btn[aria-disabled="true"]:not([aria-busy="true"]) { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-btn > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* Variants */
  .ui-btn-secondary { background-color: var(--ui-secondary); --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-secondary-foreground); }
  .ui-btn-outline {
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-foreground);
    border-color: var(--ui-border-strong);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
  }
  .ui-btn-ghost { background-color: transparent; --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-btn-soft { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 10%, transparent); --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-primary-text); }
  .ui-btn-destructive { background-color: var(--ui-destructive); --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-destructive-foreground); }
  .ui-btn-link { height: auto; padding-inline: 0; background-color: transparent; --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-primary-text); text-underline-offset: 4px; }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-secondary) 90%, var(--ui-foreground)); }
    .ui-btn-outline:hover,
    .ui-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
    .ui-btn-soft:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 16%, transparent); }
    .ui-btn-destructive:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
    .ui-btn-link:hover { background-color: transparent; text-decoration: underline; }
  }
  .ui-btn-destructive:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent); }

  /* Disabled secondary/outline keep their shape so they still read as buttons */
  .ui-btn-outline:disabled,
  .ui-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 1; --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-muted-foreground); background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted); box-shadow: none; }

  /* Sizes */
  .ui-btn-xs { height: 1.75rem; gap: 0.25rem; padding-inline: 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .ui-btn-sm { height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .ui-btn-lg { height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-size: var(--text-md); }
  .ui-btn-icon { width: 2.25rem; padding-inline: 0; }
  .ui-btn-icon.ui-btn-xs { width: 1.75rem; }
  .ui-btn-icon.ui-btn-sm { width: 2rem; }
  .ui-btn-icon.ui-btn-lg { width: 2.75rem; }
  .ui-btn-icon:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.94); }

  /* Loading: label stays in the DOM (keeps the width), spinner overlays it */
  .ui-btn[aria-busy="true"] { cursor: progress; }
  .ui-btn[aria-busy="true"] { color: transparent; }
  .ui-btn[aria-busy="true"] > :not(.ui-btn-spinner) { visibility: hidden; }
  .ui-btn-spinner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    margin: auto;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    border: 2px solid var(--ui-btn-fg);
    border-right-color: transparent;
    animation: ui-spin 0.7s linear infinite;
  }

  /* Group: <div class="ui-btn-group"> joins adjacent buttons */
  .ui-btn-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn { border-radius: 0; }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn:first-child { border-start-start-radius: var(--radius-md); border-end-start-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn:last-child { border-start-end-radius: var(--radius-md); border-end-end-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn + .ui-btn { margin-inline-start: -1px; }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn:not(.ui-btn-outline) + .ui-btn:not(.ui-btn-outline) { margin-inline-start: 0; box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 20%, transparent); }
  .ui-btn-group > .ui-btn:focus-visible { z-index: 1; }
}
```

## Usage

**Variants** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/button/variants.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';

export default function ButtonVariants() {
  return (
    <>
      <Button>Save changes</Button>
      <Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
      <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
      <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
      <Button variant="soft">Soft</Button>
      <Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
      <Button variant="link">Learn more</Button>
    </>
  );
}
```
